equations: on v >= 1: emit spike, v = 0, w += adaptation_increment
target.observation_model: mean of three 50 ms spike-count windows; three-trial count is inferred from the published 6.6667 Hz quantization and remains F/E
target.population_model: fit one parameter draw per registered training cell and retain both draws as an empirical PN-family distribution
target.selection_reason: the failed model evaluated a time-varying ramp as independent steady-state points

parameter_policy.training_only: select every per-cell parameter draw using only its registered Gugel fit curve
parameter_policy.external_trace_policy: no parameter or threshold may change after quantitative Nanami scoring

observables.loss: mean per-fit-cell Huber loss over the complete reconstructed triangular ramp
observables.held_out_rule: training and leave-one-fit-cell-out diagnostics only; consumed Gugel held-out cells remain inaccessible

observables.loss: normalized eight-level spike-count RMSE plus within-step adaptation error
observables.held_out_rule: one sealed score after model freeze; report all metrics even if they fail

external_acceptance.baseline_comparison: the dynamic family must outperform the frozen steady-state LIF on at least two of three metrics
external_acceptance.tier_policy: passing is a model-selection result only; one cell and unresolved stimulus units cannot award V1

claim_boundary: Cross-specimen PN-family dynamic-model selection using two female DL5 fit cells and one external female driver-defined PN challenge; not a population validation and not MaleCNS-donor physiology.
